name: calendar_events_quick_add
description: Creates an event based on a simple text string; the sandbox parser recognizes an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD), a time (HH:MM or 2pm), and the words 'today'/'tomorrow'; the rest becomes the title. (POST /calendars/{calendarId}/events/quickAdd)

calendar_id.description: Calendar identifier. To retrieve calendar IDs call the calendarList.list method.

text.description: The text describing the event to be created, e.g. 'Deal-desk review with Summit Group 2026-02-03 14:00'.

send_updates.description: Guests who should receive notifications about the creation of the new event. Acceptable values: 'all', 'externalOnly', 'none'. Validated only; no mail is delivered in this sandbox.
